name: Shikigami ~Kikyou no Hana ni Himetaru Omoi~
original_name: 式神 ～桔梗の華に秘めたる想い～
source:
There is a city, which has two different faces. The city is filled with people during day, and a monster called "Hizumi (strain)" appears during night. Tsukasa is "Shade", who protects this world from the monster with his sword. The unescapable fate awaits him....

[From ErogeShop]

Combat sequences in this story are played as card-game battles.
translation:
有一座拥有两副面孔的城市。白天人潮涌动，夜晚则会出现一种名为"歪"的怪物。司是"影"的一员，用他的剑守护着这个世界免受怪物侵袭。无法逃避的命运在等待着他……

[改编自ErogeShop]

本作的战斗场景以卡牌对战的形式进行。
